title: Three Young Women in Formal Prom Gowns, 1950s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: Three young women pose together outdoors dressed in elegant floor-length formal gowns, likely attending a high school prom, formal dance, or wedding in the late 1940s to early 1950s. Two of them wear overcoats draped across their shoulders to ward off the chill, and each has a floral corsage pinned to her bodice or lapel. Their curled hairstyles, classic post-war draped gown silhouettes, and wire-rimmed glasses epitomize mid-century youth fashion and social culture.
